points: Host workloads, or ask if they really need AI.

start.dailyBody: Same campus and same luck for everyone today, in {location}.
start.challengeBody: Same campus, same luck. Can you beat their legacy score?

paris-basin.question: Wind, sun, river: all average here. So what decides?
paris-basin.answer: No single clean source is enough, so you mix them, and land runs out. Efficiency and how much you grow matter more than any one plant.

nordic-fjord.question: Clean power is easy here. So why is it hard to get rich?
nordic-fjord.answer: You are far from users: clients pay less and the market is small. Green is cheap here; growth is not.

coal-valley.question: Coal is cheap here. What's the catch?
coal-valley.answer: Coal emits about 75 times more CO₂ per kWh than wind over its life. Once carbon has a price, the cheap plant becomes the expensive one.

sun-belt.question: Sun everywhere. What runs out first?
sun-belt.answer: Water. Evaporative cooling and thermal plants drink it, and farms and towns need it too. Solar panels barely use any.

onboarding.text: {maxTicks} quarters to play. Tap a plot to build
Halls need power: build a plant first
A red ! means a hall has no power
Sustainability below {taxThreshold}? An eco‑tax eats your revenue
Wrong building? Tap it, demolish it, build again

steps.text: One quarter every few seconds, {maxTicks} quarters in a run ({years} years, about 5 minutes). Pause or speed up anytime.
Accept, refuse, or propose a lighter alternative. Does it really need AI?

Tap a plot to build a datacenter hall or a power plant. There is no grid: halls only run on the power you build (a red "!" means a hall has no power). Tap a building to upgrade it; every upgrade has a trade-off you can see, some hide a bill you can't. Wrong building in the wrong place? Tap it and demolish it (for a fee, no refund) to build something else, for example wind instead of coal.

Sustainability (what your campus does to the planet) and Responsibility (how you decide). Coal is cheap and compact, wind and sun are clean but need land. If Sustainability drops below {taxThreshold}, an eco-tax takes a share of your revenue every quarter: the lower the score, the bigger the bite.
= profit × impact. Pure greed and pure virtue both lose to a smart balance.

game.subtitle: Build your empire. Mind your footprint.
game.emptyReport: Press play. Clients will knock soon.
game.tapForInfo: Tap a score to see what it means.

cash.label: Cash balance
cash.tooltip: Money in the bank. Below −€1M you are bankrupt and the run ends.

power.label: Power
power.tooltip: There is no grid. Your plants must cover what your halls draw (IT load × PUE), or the last halls go dark.

sustainability.label: Sustainability
sustainability.tooltip: What your datacenter does to the planet, measured: cooling efficiency, carbon, water where it is scarce, server life cycle and total energy compared with day one.

responsibility.label: Responsibility
responsibility.tooltip: How you decide: questioning the need, measuring before claiming, being honest. Trust fades: it drifts back to 50 unless you keep earning it.

envDebt.label: Environmental debt
envDebt.tooltip: The bill nobody has sent yet. Smoke, water and waste pile up out of sight; when it is high, fines, rules and angry neighbours arrive.

debt.label: Low
warnings: Birds on the cooling towers. All calm.

debt.label: Rising
warnings: A local blog asks about your water use.
Someone posted a photo of your smoke.
The river looks a bit lower this summer.

debt.label: High
warnings: A petition is going around the village.

debt.label: Critical
warnings: Protesters at the gate this morning.
Your biggest client wants a call about 'reputation'.
